data.title: A Green Beret's Humanitarian Mission to Remove Ukraine's Landmines Now Streaming on Prime Video in the U.S. and UK
data.description: A new documentary titled "Safe Ground: A Green Beret's Mission to Remove Ukraine's Landmines" sheds light on the journey of Ryan Hendrickson. The retired U.S. Army Green Beret, who is a Purple Heart and Silver Star awardee, is also an author and the founder of Tip of. The film showcases his efforts in clearing landmines in Ukraine.

data.title: Calvin Klein Collection by Veronica Leoni Spring 2027 Runway Show Presented in New York City
data.description: Yesterday in New York City, Calvin Klein, Inc., a subsidiary of PVH Corp. [NYSE:PVH], showcased the Calvin Klein Collection Spring 2027 runway exhibit by Creative Director Veronica Leoni at Terminal Warehouse. The show continued the theme of American Minimalism, emphasizing the concept of stripping down to the essentials. According to Veronica Leoni, Creative Director of Calvin Klein, American Minimalism focuses on removing any elements that do not serve the purpose of the work, leaving behind only the necessary components.

data.title: Media reporters at The Times focus on newsrooms and their leaders, not the journalists themselves.
data.description: Reporters typically strive to avoid being the subjects of news stories themselves, but for media journalists at The Times, the focus has shifted to the newsrooms and their leadership. This change in narrative shines a spotlight on the inner workings of news organizations and the individuals in charge.

data.title: Reform UK receives $97M from two crypto billionaires: BitMEX co-founder Ben Delo donates $50M, followed by Christopher Harborne.
data.description: Co-founder of BitMEX, Ben Delo, contributed nearly $50 million to Nigel Farage's Reform UK party, with an additional matching donation of the same amount made by Christopher Harborne the following day.

data.title: Increasing number of online influencers resorting to risky content to gain followers, despite safety concerns.
data.description: An increasing amount of individuals on social media are challenging boundaries of safety and decorum in order to cater to algorithms and gain followers.

data.title: Revolut exposed passports, bitcoin records to fake govt request via official email, impacting "limited" users.
data.description: The fintech company recently responded to a fraudulent information request originating from an email domain belonging to a government agency. This led to the exposure of ID documents and complete crypto transaction histories for a select number of users on their platform. The extent of the breach is significant, impacting a "limited" number of individuals.

data.title: Larry Ellison Cancels His Plan to Sell Oracle Stock
data.description: In Austin, Texas on September 12, 2026, Oracle Corporation (NYSE: ORCL) made the announcement that Larry Ellison, the Executive Chair of the Board and Chief Technology Officer, has decided to cancel his 10b5-1 Plan for selling Oracle stock. It is important to note that no Oracle stock was sold through this plan. Ellison confirmed that he does not have any other plans to sell Oracle stock.

data.title: North Korea relies on foreign IT workers to infiltrate US companies, with North Korean operatives taking over positions.
data.description: North Korea has been employing IT professionals from other countries to pass job interviews, following which the roles are typically assumed by North Korean agents.

data.title: A Civilian Legend Reimagined: Jeep® Brand Introduces 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A
data.description: The latest release in Jeep® brand's Twelve 4 Twelve lineup is the 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A, marking the 11th drop in the series. This special edition model pays homage to the Willys CJ-2A, recognized as the inaugural Jeep vehicle crafted for civilian use. Through the 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A, the contemporary Wrangler lineup is linked back to the roots of the CJ-2A, a groundbreaking vehicle that paved the way for future Jeep models.

data.title: UK receives a record $97M from crypto billionaires in donations, surpassing total contributions of all political parties in 2020.
data.description: Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne collectively donated a total of £72 million, surpassing the total funds raised by all political parties in the UK last year.

data.title: PureHealth Research Highlights Targeted Nutritional Support for Digestive Comfort With Acid Reflux Supplements
data.description: A company based in Manassas, Virginia, called PureHealth Research, has brought attention to a rising trend in consumer focus on digestive health. They emphasize the importance of targeted nutrition in supporting daily digestive well-being. Specifically, the company emphasizes the benefits of acid reflux supplements, which are tailored nutritional products designed to promote digestive comfort. The information was released on September 12, 2026, via PRNewswire.

data.title: GAC AION UT Wins Best Exterior Design at the 2026 Torino Automotive Design Award
data.description: In Turin, Italy on September 12, 2026, the AION UT by GAC emerged victorious at the 2026 Torino Automotive Design Award (TADA) for Best Exterior Design during the Salone Auto Torino 2026 event. The award was given in recognition of the model's unique visual characteristics and symbolizes GAC's dedication to developing electric vehicles.

data.title: CBE's 233 MW Kamoa Project Comes Online with AIKO ABC Modules
data.description: In YIWU, China on September 12, 2026, CrossBoundary Energy (CBE) announced the successful connection of its 233 MW Kamoa solar project in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to the grid, marking the commencement of its commercial operation. This achievement was reached within a mere 16 months from the signing of the power purchase agreement.

data.title: Ajman Department of Tourism, Culture & Media Showcases Emirate's Tourism Offerings at Arabian Travel Market 2026
data.description: The Ajman Department of Tourism, Culture, and Media from the UAE will be present at the Arabian Travel Market 2026 at the Dubai World Trade Centre starting on September 14 until September 17. The event's theme is "Travel 2040: Driving New Frontiers Through Innovation."

data.title: USPS Salutes the U.S. Coast Guard Academy's 150 Years
data.description: A new stamp has been released to honor the dedication of Coast Guard cadets, reflecting the motto "Semper Paratus" (Always Ready). The stamp was issued on September 12, 2026, in New London, Connecticut. This stamp is part of the Postal Service's ongoing tradition of recognizing American military academies.

data.title: Pizza Experts Kelly and Brian Glynn Explain How Pizza Brings People Together in HelloNation
data.description: An article delves into the role of pizza in fostering connections through family customs, festive occasions, informal get-togethers, and joint moments. Recently in Columbia, S.C., on Sept. 12, 2026, a PRNewswire report examined the reasons behind the communal appeal of pizza. Referring to insights from Pizza Experts Kelly and Brian, the piece sheds light on the significance of this popular dish in bringing people together.

data.title: Nvidia contemplates $10B investment in possible record Anthropic IPO, aiming to raise up to $100B and hit a valuation of $2T.
data.description: It has been reported that Anthropic is currently looking to raise up to $100 billion through an offering, potentially resulting in the valuation of the AI company at around $2 trillion.

data.title: Privacy battle in GTA V as mod introduces flock cameras; players can eliminate tracking devices. #GTA #Privacy #Mod
data.description: A new modification in GTA V is sparking a privacy battle in Los Santos, allowing players to destroy surveillance cameras that are monitoring them. This mod introduces a gameplay element centered around privacy infringement and rebellion against surveillance in the virtual world. Players can now actively engage in taking down cameras within the game, adding a new dimension to gameplay. This feature has garnered attention for its unique twist on the typical GTA experience. As players navigate the city, they can locate and demolish a total of 50 surveillance cameras strategically placed throughout the game, highlighting the significance of privacy in an increasingly monitored society. This mod has resonated with the gaming community, sparking discussions on surveillance and privacy rights both in-game and in the real world. With the ability to actively resist surveillance within the game, players are able to immerse themselves in a new aspect of gameplay that challenges traditional norms. The mod has quickly gained popularity, with thousands of downloads and positive feedback from players worldwide.
